scope: Only parsed public Ethernet, IPv4/IPv6, UDP, ICMP, ESP SPI/sequence, MACsec SecTAG and L2TPv3 data headers are emitted. Packet payload and ciphertext bytes are never serialized. MACsec encrypted content is never parsed. IPv4 transport headers require a valid complete IHL/total length and zero fragment offset. The selected L2TPv3 contract is UDP, no cookie and a four-byte default L2-specific sublayer, corroborated by actual tunnel/session state. Up to two802.1Q/802.1ad VLAN tags are parsed, including reconstruction from Linux PACKET_AUXDATA when supplied. Deeper tags and other L2TP cookie/sublayer arrangements remain unsupported. Opaque EtherType payload bytes remain unparsed.
